meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Podverse: hide the My Library nav, theme switch and queue links; dim or hide category tiles. Podcast cards never rendered during research.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on podverse.fm/ (redirected to /podcasts). Not captured: an iPhone-UA page, podcast and episode pages, clips and the player with an episode (the network and machine were out of resources when retried).

LIVE counts on /podcasts: library-nav desktop home 7; theme-toggle desktop home 1; tiles-dim desktop home 19; tiles-hide desktop home 19. Selectors are readable class names (navbar__link, navbar__section-header, tile-box) and aria labels; the player is react-h5-audio-player (`.rhap_container`) and is never touched. No cookie, ad or app banner was present, so the generic 1.0.0 rules match nothing.

Choice: Category tiles Show/Dim/Hide (opacity 0.35). The My Library links are hidden by href; they all need a login.

NOT verified: podcast and episode cards (so no artwork or counter rules), phone layout, signed-in pages, other pages that may reuse `.tile-box`.
